_comment: The exact tool surface a published stdio build is allowed to expose.
CI compares this list against a real MCP handshake with the built server.
src/tools.ts can register additional tools depending on the context it is
given: src/http.ts gates those on an env var, src/index.ts does not.
Adding a name to this list changes what every npx and .mcpb user receives.
That is a product decision. Do not edit this file to turn a red check green.
